decision: PASS for the supplied static whole-image scope: no definite visible wrapping, clipping, overlap, mathematical-spacing, or figure-framing defect was observed. Fine-detail uncertainty is retained explicitly, not converted into an automatic approval of other gates.
staticViewLimits: Only the eight supplied whole originals were viewed, once each, with no reopen, crop, zoom, derived image, or other image.
A saved viewport or image boundary is an evidence limit, not automatically a broken container. Nothing outside these saved pixels was inferred.
Automatic tool scaling is documented above; no exact small-glyph transcription, font identity, font loading, rendered-font metric, or minimum-text-size certification is made.
No interaction, answer judging, keyboard behavior, scrolling behavior, ARIA, complete English accessibility, unseen state, or headed acceptance is certified.
Source fidelity, scientific correctness, English wording, and choice semantics are outside this pixel review.
